text:
oncall-bot: ALERT triggered: embedding-service-eu-west high 5xx rate (503s) — ~18% error-rate over last 3m, paging primary oncall. Pager: @ashwin.

ashwin: seeing it, tailing logs now. KV cache pressure looks noisy, but ingress shows a spike from region eu-west-1a.

maria: customer-impact: Support flagged 4 customers on paid tiers reporting timeouts. Notified account teams, asked for SLAs triage.

jessica: quick mitigation idea — divert low-priority realtime requests to eu-central read-only pool and scale down batching window. Can we flip routing policy?

ashwin: trying manual route override now. command: ```/run reroute --svc embedding-service --from eu-west-1a --to eu-central-1 --weight 0.25```

oncall-bot: reroute job created (job id 0a7f). Progress: 40% applied to active load balancers.

ryan: FYI the autoscaler hasn't reacted because of pod eviction backpressure; investigating kube events. Looks like a node on eu-west-1a had oom-kill for batch-worker-3.

ashwin: found repeated GC+OOM logs on that node. Marking node unhealthy and cordoning. ```kubectl cordon node/eu-west-1a-03 && kubectl drain node/eu-west-1a-03 --ignore-daemonsets```

maria: communication note — posting to #support-updates with status + ETA. Suggested public message: "We're routing some traffic to alternate region; intermittent 503s persist for a subset of eu-west requests. Working on node recovery."
